perks.name: Nightmarish Power
perks.description: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring an Elite+ Kill:
Grants Unstable Essence for 15 seconds.
Scoring additional Elite+ Kills refresh the buff duration.

Unstable Essence | +30 Melee Stat and +30 Grenade Stat.

perks.name: Nightmarish Resilience
perks.description: When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.
perks.exact:
While Unstable Essence is active:
Upon scoring a total of 8 weapon damage instances within 3 seconds of each, counted up to once every 0.45 seconds: 
Begins Critical Health Regeneration and restores 20 HP.
Incurs a 2 second cooldown upon triggering before hits count again. 
Perk takes AT LEAST 3.6 seconds to initially trigger, then 5.6 seconds for the next reactivation assuming nonstop damage.

item.name: Special Ammo Scout
item.description: When you fill your Special ammo meter, it also creates smaller bricks of Special ammo for your allies.
item.exact:
Upon spawning a Mod-Matching Ammo Brick:
Allies receive a copy of the Ammo Brick.

Ammo Scout Brick Pickup Amounts:
37% | 67% | 100% of a regular Ammo Brick's.

Enhanced Brick Chance is determined by the ally's Weapons Stat.

item.name: Harmonic Siphon
item.description: Rapid Arc weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
Upon scoring 2 Mod-Element Matching Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each:

Spawns an Orb of Power.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orbs of Power before additional kills count.

Orb of Power:
2.5% | 3.75% | 4.4% Super Energy.

item.name: Dreambane Mod
item.description: Reduces the damage you take from Nightmare Hunt bosses. Multiple copies of this mod stack for greater effect.
item.exact:
5% Damage Resist per Stack against Nightmare Bosses.
Maxes out at 25% Damage Resist with 5 Mods.
